description.text: Program Description: The graduates are famous for their solid theoretical foundation, high comprehensive quality and strong adaptability. It requires students to have a solid foundation of legal theory, and systematically grasp the legal knowledge and legal provisions in the fields of constitution, civil law, criminal law, administrative law, economic law, litigation law, international law, resources and environmental law, understand the development of law theory and domestic legislation information at home and abroad, and be able to master a foreign language skillfully. Foreign language books and periodicals. In terms of capacity, students should be able to apply the relevant legal knowledge and legal provisions to handle all kinds of legal affairs, solve various legal disputes, and have the ability and quality to engage in legal practice and legal research work. Training requirements Graduates should acquire the following knowledge and abilities: 1.Grasp the basic theories and basic knowledge of various disciplines of law; 2.Mastering the basic analytical methods and techniques of law; 3.Understand the theoretical frontier of law and the trend of legal system construction; 4. Familiar with the laws of our country and the relevant policies of the party; 5. Has the ability to use legal knowledge to understand problems and deal with problems. 6. Mastering the basic methods of literature search and data inquiry, and have the ability of scientific research and practical work. Internship: Include probation, legal consultation, social investigation, thematic debate, analogue trial, doubtful case debate, practice and so on, in general not less than 20 weeks. Duration: 5 years

duration.text: The Law at Dalian Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be between 18 and 25 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate
